cut_observations.observation: Aluminium veranda entry cuts to a forward-moving Douglas pavilion scene; no dissolve or geometry morph.
Coffee cup is on the table and hand has withdrawn before the cut to the glass action.
Glass motion retained through the end of its chosen range; distinct panel edge remains visible before the consultation cut.
Adviser has lifted his head toward the homeowner before the garden-room reveal begins.
Both people remain present, cup is lowered and the garden stays visible. No artificial black or still-frame tail was added.
